messages.author: 5da9c77a55fe2db6
messages.subject: tip shape
parts:
Hi all,

I tried to use the followings to color nodes (e.g. node 2, 4, 6) and label them with specific symbol (e.g. shape = 16) as well

---
tree = rtree(10)
colorr = rep("black",19)
colorr[c(2,4,6)] = "red"
dd = data.frame(node=1:19, colorr)

shapee= rep(NA,10)
shapee[c(2,4,6)] = 1

ggtree(tree) %<+% dd + aes(color=I(colorr)) + geom_tippoint(shape=shapee, size =2 )

---

However, in the resulting tree, a tip with symbol did not appear to the one with color.
I think the coloring is right but don't know how to label the tip with symbol correctly.



Thank you for your reading
